question:
Based on the situation in the sentence, select the most appropriate idiom.

After many years of rivalry, the two schools decided to _______ and participate in a National Event together.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"bury the hatchet"** means to end a conflict or feud and become friendly. (शत्रुता समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of disputes, the two neighbors decided **to bury the hatchet** and live peacefully
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bell the cat **(जोखिम उठाना): To undertake a risky or dangerous task.

 
 
• **Example:** The plan sounds good, but who will bell the cat?
 
 
 
• **Be in the doldrums **(निष्क्रियता की स्थिति में होना ): To be in a state of inactivity or depression.
 
 
• **Example: **After losing his job, he was in the doldrums for months.
 
 
 
• **Go cold turkey** (अचानक आदत छोड़ना): To stop a habit abruptly and completely.
 
 
• **Example:** He went cold turkey on caffeine after realizing its negative effects on his health.
 
 

41:Tb90,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
